**AI Coding Platform / Tool Name**
Name of the AI coding tool or environment (e.g. GitHub Copilot Workspace, Aider, Devin, Continue.dev).

**Configuration Mechanism**
How does this tool consume custom skills, instructions, or rules?
- [ ] System prompt injection
- [ ] Dotfile / rules file (e.g. `.continuerules`)
- [ ] Directory-based skills format (like Claude Code or Antigravity)
- [ ] MCP Server / JSON tool declaration
- [ ] Other: 

**Documentation Reference**
Link to official documentation explaining how the platform loads skills or prompt rules.

**Why Should This Environment Be Supported?**
Explain why supporting this environment benefits developer workflows.
